name: cube-pager
summary: Swipeable pages that turn like the faces of a cube, with flick momentum.
props: Outside of a cube, its inner walls, or each page spinning in place.
Darken faces as they turn away.
Turn swiping off (dots and a controlled index still work).
behavior: Pages follow your finger. A quick flick or a drag past 35% turns the page, and the first and last pages rubber-band.
Pages rotate around their shared edge in 3D (cube, inside or flip) and darken as they turn away when shade is on.
The pager is adjustable with a "2 / 5" value and increment and decrement actions. Off-screen pages are hidden and dots are buttons.
